subject: SIEM-ready audit export (beta) — SRE launch readiness checklist + go/no-go
thread_body:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jan 16, 2025 at 5:42 PM PST
Subject: SIEM-ready audit export (beta) — SRE launch readiness checklist + go/no-go
Attachments: audit-export_beta_launch-readiness-checklist_v0.9.pdf

Team —

We’re targeting enabling the SIEM-ready audit export beta behind flag early next week. Before we do, I want a crisp go/no-go based on SRE launch readiness.

Attached is the checklist we’ll use for the go/no-go. Please review and reply with “green / yellow / red” for your area + any remaining blockers.

Minimum bar (for GO):
- SLOs published and alertable (Hosted + Private where applicable)
- Dashboard live (delivery latency, success rate, backlog/DLQ, connector errors)
- Paging policy + owner routing confirmed (who gets paged, when, and how we mitigate)
- Runbook complete enough for 2am (backlog drain, pause destination, replay window, poison-pill handling, credential rotation)
- Rollback/disable plan confirmed (feature flag, per-tenant denylist/allowlist, stop-the-bleed actions)

Proposed go/no-go: Mon Jan 20, 10:00–10:30am PT. Connor — can you hold the release window pending this decision?

Key links:
- SLOs: /eng-sre/slo-and-error-budgets/audit-export-slos
- Runbook: /eng-sre/runbooks/audit-export-backlog-drain-replay
- Service doc: /eng-platform/systems-and-services/audit-export-service

Thanks,
Sean

—
Sean Gallagher
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 17, 2025 at 9:18 AM PST
Subject: Re: SIEM-ready audit export (beta) — SRE launch readiness checklist + go/no-go

Observability: GREEN (with 1 small follow-up)

- Dashboards from observability-pack/pr_0331 are merged and deployed to staging + prod.
- Panels included: E2E delivery latency (p50/p95), per-destination success/fail, retry rate, backlog depth, DLQ volume, connector error taxonomy (4xx auth, 429 throttling, 5xx upstream, schema/validation).
- Alerts: initial thresholds wired (see ENG-13931). Paging hooks are set but I want a final sign-off on paging thresholds before we let it page the primary on-call.

Ask: Rafael/Sean — confirm the paging thresholds you want for beta (I suggested:
- Page if success rate < 99.5% for 15m AND backlog increasing
- Page if backlog estimate > 30m for 20m
- Page if DLQ growth > 100 events/10m
)

Allison

—
Allison Grant
Observability Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 17, 2025 at 11:06 AM PST
Subject: Re: SIEM-ready audit export (beta) — SRE launch readiness checklist + go/no-go
Attachments: pager_policy_audit-export_oncall_v1.2.docx

SRE/Paging: YELLOW

What’s done:
- On-call routing set up in PagerDuty: “Platform Control Plane” primary, “SRE” secondary. (We can adjust after the first 2 beta customers.)
- Escalation policy drafted and attached.
- Stop-the-bleed actions validated in staging: pause destination, reduce worker concurrency, disable HEC ACK, and (last resort) disable tenant flag.

Remaining:
1) We still need final confirmation on whether audit-export pages the primary control-plane on-call vs SRE for the beta period. My recommendation:
   - Control plane pages for connector/auth and backlog/latency issues
   - SRE pages only for multi-tenant impact (worker crash loops, queue integrity, widespread retries)

2) Runbook: mostly complete, but replay tooling section references “TBD API endpoint” (ENG-13934). We can still launch as long as the operator replay command in the runbook is accurate for Hosted (even if Private lags).

On Allison’s alert thresholds: agree with the structure. I’d slightly relax for beta:
- Page if backlog > 60m for 20m (not 30m)
- DLQ page threshold should be relative to baseline; suggest 200/10m for beta.

Rafael

—
Rafael Mendes
SRE Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 17, 2025 at 1:22 PM PST
Subject: Re: SIEM-ready audit export (beta) — SRE launch readiness checklist + go/no-go

Security Eng: YELLOW (close)

Not blocking launch, but we need to be explicit about what we’ll do if a customer misconfigures a destination and starts exporting to the wrong place.

Two items:
1) Confirm we have an audit trail for export config changes (create/update/delete destination; change filters; pause/resume). We need those events in the standard audit log stream and they need to include actor + workspace/tenant.
2) Credential handling: ensure error logs and DLQ entries do not contain destination secrets/tokens (Splunk HEC token, Datadog API key). We saw a staging log line last week that printed a redacted header object but not consistently.

If these are already addressed via RBAC + audit logging PR (redwood/pr_28427) and log scrubbers, please reply with pointers and I’ll flip to GREEN.

Marcus

—
Marcus Lin
Security Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, Jan 17, 2025 at 3:05 PM PST
Subject: Re: SIEM-ready audit export (beta) — SRE launch readiness checklist + go/no-go

Platform sponsor: GREEN with one requirement

We should not launch if we don’t have a clear backpressure plan that prevents audit-export retries from impacting the primary API.

My understanding:
- Export is decoupled from request path (good)
- Worker concurrency caps + per-destination circuit breaker protect against retry storms (need confirmation it’s enabled in prod config)
- Feature flag rollback exists per tenant (redwood/pr_28445)

Ask: Sean/Benji — please confirm the prod defaults for concurrency + retry/backoff + circuit breaker, and the operator action if Splunk starts returning 5xx and backlog grows (pause destination vs global dampening).

Priya

—
Priya Natarajan
Engineering Sponsor, Platform Control Plane

Date: Sat, Jan 18, 2025 at 10:47 AM PST
Subject: Re: SIEM-ready audit export (beta) — SRE launch readiness checklist + go/no-go

Product/Compliance: GREEN

For beta contract language and docs, we’re explicitly stating:
- At-least-once delivery, duplicates possible; customers should dedupe on event.id (and optionally event.hash)
- No guarantee of strict ordering across partitions/destinations
- Explicit failure states and per-destination health in Console

I’d like SRE confirmation that we can measure and report:
- delivery latency p95 over a rolling window
- “dropped” definition (should be 0; anything else routes to DLQ / visible)

If we’re aligned there, I’m comfortable with GO for a limited cohort.

Naomi

—
Naomi Feldman
PM, Security & Compliance

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 20, 2025 at 10:14 AM PST
Subject: Re: SIEM-ready audit export (beta) — SRE launch readiness checklist + go/no-go

Go/No-Go outcome: GO (beta cohort only) with two launch conditions

Thanks all. Summary of readiness + decisions from this morning:

1) Paging policy (final):
- Primary page: Platform Control Plane on-call for per-destination issues (auth, throttling, connector 5xx, backlog growth)
- Secondary: SRE for widespread worker/queue failures and multi-tenant impact
- For beta we’ll use Rafael’s relaxed thresholds:
  - Page if success rate < 99.5% for 15m AND backlog increasing
  - Page if backlog estimate > 60m for 20m
  - Page if DLQ growth > 200 events / 10m
(All of the above are explicitly scoped to audit-export alerts; no coupling to API availability paging.)

2) Backpressure / impact mitigation (Priya’s requirement):
- Confirmed prod defaults: concurrency capped (per-destination + global), exponential backoff with jitter, circuit breaker trips on sustained 5xx/429 and pauses destination automatically after N failures.
- Operator action for “Splunk 5xx + rising backlog”: pause destination first; do not globally increase retries. If multiple destinations impacted, reduce worker concurrency and consider temporarily disabling HEC ACK.

3) Security items (Marcus):
- Export config change events are in the audit stream via redwood/pr_28427 (create/update/delete destination; pause/resume; filter changes) including actor + tenant.
- Connector logs/DLQ entries scrub secrets; any occurrence of tokens/keys in logs is a sev-worthy bug. Allison will add a log-based detector for common token patterns in exporter logs for beta.

4) Product measurement alignment (Naomi):
- “Dropped” should be 0 by definition; anything undeliverable routes to DLQ and counts against success SLI.
- Delivery latency p95 is measured end-to-end from audit event ingest timestamp to sink ACK/write confirmation.

Launch conditions (must be true before enabling first tenant):
A) Allison to flip alert routing from “notify only” to paging in prod after final threshold config is pushed.
B) Rafael to update runbook replay section to reflect current operator process (even if ENG-13934 API is not GA).

Connor — OK to proceed with release window for flag gating only. Naomi — please keep cohort to the agreed 2 design partners for week 1.

Sean

—
Sean Gallagher
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
